description: Launch a paid crowdsourced DATA_COLLECTION program: post what data you need (TEXT, CONVERSATION/SFT, MEDIA, or STRUCTURED), a per-item price, target count, and budget cap. The FULL cap is escrow-held from prepaid credits (402 = top up first); vetted contributors submit through the OpenTrain editor; items are screened (format, dedup, gold) and accepted via human review or peer consensus; accepted items accrue per-contribution payouts. Requires jobs:write. Poll opentrain_get_collection_status; fetch accepted items with opentrain_list_collection_contributions.

config.description: CollectionProgramConfig: contributionType, prompt, criteria, perContributionCents, targetCount, budgetCapCents, acceptanceMode, captureRequirements? (mobile targeting: modalities/sensors/device/countries/languages), ...

name: opentrain_collect_data
